param.name: mlabel
param.label: Label
param.help: Label to use in the report. If not given the dataset name is used.

param.name: resolutions
param.label: Resolutions of an mcool file
param.help: Space separated, e.g. 10000 50000. If empty, all resolutions of an mcool file are analysed. Ignored for a cool file.

validator.message: Only numbers separated by spaces are allowed.

param.label: Short range cut-off (bp)
param.help: Cis contacts closer than this distance between bin starts are short range. The cut-off is exact up to one bin size.

param.label: Contacts per bin for the map resolution
Fraction of bins for the map resolution
Flag chromosome pairs above this observed over expected ratio
Number of chromosomes with rows of their own
param.help: The longest chromosomes get their own rows in the decay, coverage and trans tables. The genome-wide statistics use all chromosomes.

tool.help:
Quality control of Hi-C matrices ================================
hicMatrixQC writes a report for finished cool or mcool matrices, the counterpart of the BAM based QC of hicBuildMatrix. The report is an HTML page without scripts, and the statistics are also written as a table with one column per sample. An mcool file gives one sample per resolution.
The report contains
- the counts of the hicBuildMatrix QC log and the distribution of the read pairs over distance and read pair type, if hicBuildMatrix (version 4) stored them in the matrix (metadata key hicexplorer_qc), - contacts, cis and trans fractions, short range and long range contacts, and the fractions of the main diagonal and of the first off-diagonal, - the contact distance curve P(s) and its decay exponent, genome-wide and per chromosome, - the map resolution after Rao et al. 2014 (the smallest bin size at which 80% of the bins have at least 1000 contacts), - the coverage per bin, the empty bins, and the bins the MAD filter of hicCorrectMatrix would remove, - the state of the balancing weights, - the observed over expected trans contacts of every pair of chromosomes, - the X over autosome coverage ratio and the presence of chromosome Y and chromosome M.
Distances between bins are distances between bin starts, so distance thresholds are exact only up to one bin size. Counts are the raw counts of the stored pixels. Matrices with bins of different sizes only get the statistics stored by hicBuildMatrix.
